com.esignal.jstandard.beans.news

Class Headline

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.news.Headline
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    Story

    public abstract class Headline
extends java.lang.Object
    This class is used to send the Headline information back to the client using the HeadlineEvent using the NewsListener or NewsRequestListener Interfaces.
    Since:
    01-019-0000
    Author:
    Interactive Data
    See Also:
    HeadlineEvent
